descriptions.w3d_d28g_crate_fall_step_8004bdf8: Crate step: hands over once exploded; while enabled and not grounded it sweeps down from the position less the height at +64 with gravity from two rates, and on contact posts a message, runs the indexed dispatch when idle and bounces along the normalized global vector; below the water height it marks exploded; otherwise it integrates position and velocity with step 20, easing fall speed toward -0.055 while the parachute flag at +112 is set. Disabled or grounded crates release the object at +244.
